How ordering works

  1. Pick your dishesBrowse by dosa style or search, then add what you like.
  2. Choose how you want itDelivery, takeaway or dine-in, with your name and phone number.

      Good to know

      How do I order?

      Open the Order page, add your dishes, choose delivery, takeaway or dine-in, enter your details and pay.

      How can I pay?

      Pay with the UPI QR when it is shown, or choose Cash / card.

      Will I get a bill?

      Yes. A bill with your items, total and payment method is created as soon as payment is confirmed.
